sentences.text:
Kalipada Patra & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 8
May, 2025
S/L 10
08.05.2025

Court. No. 19
Suvayan
 Wpa 8655 of 2024
 Kalipada Patra & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Dwarikanath Mukheree
Mr. Sujit Bhunia
...for the petitioners.

Mr. Supratim Dhar, Sr. Adv.
 Miss. Molly Saha
 ...for the State.
 Mr. T. M. Siddiqui, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Tanoy Chakraborty
 Mr. S. Adak
 ...for the respondent no. 4.
1.
The affidavit-of-service as filed today is taken on record.

2.  Mr. Dhar, learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents/State and its functionaries submits a report dated 25.04.2024 as submitted by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Paschim Medinipur.
The said report is also taken on record.

3. At the time of hearing Mr. Sujit Bhunia, learned Advocate duly led by Mr. Dwarikanath Mukherjee, learned Advocate appearing for the writ petitioners at the very outset draws attention of this Court to page no. 28 of the instant writ petition being a copy of the letter dated 06.10.2023 as written by the writ petitioners addressed to the different functionaries of the State who are the respondents/authorities before this Court.

4. It is submitted on behalf of the writ petitioners that under cover of the said letter dated 06.10.2023 it has been communicated to the respondents/authorities that Plot no. 49, Mouza - Jigharpur, JL no. 229, P.S. - Kharagpur (L), District - Paschim Medinipur previously 2.05 acres out of 2.61 acres in the said plot of land was acquired by the respondents/State for which the writ petitioners and/or their predecessor in interest has already received adequate compensation in terms of the award passed in a LA proceeding.

5. It is submitted further that under cover of the said letter dated 06.10.2023 it has been communicated to the respondents/authorities that in the self-same plot of land 0.56 decimals of Kalipada Patra & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28817402/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: land belonging to the writ petitioners have been occupied and used by the state/authorities without initiating any process of acquisition and without disbursing any compensation.

It is thus submitted that in view of such and in view of the inaction on the part of the respondents/authorities appropriate relief may be granted to the writ petitioners in terms of the prayers made in the instant writ petition.

6. Per contra, Mr. Dhar, learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents/State and its functionaries submits before this Court that from the report as submitted today it would reveal that the writ petitioners have not disclosed that which authority of the respondents/State has allegedly using 0.56 decimals of land in the said plot of land.
It is thus submitted that the prayer as made in the instant writ petition is vague.

7. On careful consideration of the entire materials as placed before this Court and after hearing the learned Advocates for the contending parties, this Court while disposing the instant writ petition directs the respondent no. 7/authority to make a field enquiry after serving previous notices to the writ petitioners and on conclusion of such enquiry he shall submit a report with the respondent no.
3/authority.
8.

The respondent no. 3 on receipt of such report from the respondent no. 7 shall consider the representation of the writ petitioners dated 06.10.2023 in the light of the said report and after giving an opportunity of hearing to the writ petitioners and/or their legal representatives shall pass a reasoned order and shall communicate such reasoned order to the writ petitioners forthwith preferably through mail, if the mail details of the writ petitioners are provided to him at the time of hearing.

9. It is made clear that the entire exercise as indicated in the foregoing paragraph is to be completed by the respondent nos. 7 and 3 within 90 working days from the date of communication of the server copies of this order.

10. Liberty is given to the learned Advocate-on-Record to forward server copies of this order together with a copy of the letter dated 06.10.2023 to the respondent nos. 3 and 7 for their due compliance.
11. Respondent nos. 3 and 7 are directed to act on the server copies of this order.

12. Before parting with it is made clear that while disposing the instant writ petition this Court has not gone into the merit of the instant writ petition as well as of the representation 06.10.2023 and,
therefore, it is further made clear that all points are kept open.
13.
With the aforementioned observation, the instant writ petition being WPA 8655 of 2024 is disposed of.
14. Urgent Xerox certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties upon compliance of all necessary formalities.
